test_dataframe_apply: test the DataFrame apply method to apply a function along rows or columns with axis parameter
test_dataframe_agg: test the DataFrame agg method to aggregate using one or more operations like min, max, sum
test_apply_result_type_broadcast: test DataFrame apply with result_type broadcast to return a DataFrame of repeated scalar values
test_apply_result_type_expand: test DataFrame apply with result_type expand to return a DataFrame from list returns
test_apply_result_type_reduce: test DataFrame apply with result_type reduce to return a Series from reduction operations
test_apply_raw_parameter: test DataFrame apply with raw=True to pass rows as numpy arrays instead of Series objects
test_apply_engine_numba: test DataFrame apply with engine numba for accelerated numeric computation
test_apply_by_row_dict: test DataFrame apply with dict-like ops and by_row parameter to control row-wise or column-wise application
test_apply_by_row_list: test DataFrame apply with list-like ops and by_row parameter for multiple function application
test_agg_args_kwargs: test DataFrame agg with positional args and keyword arguments passed to the aggregation function
